name: Cathedral
notes: Densely shaded, cool in summer.

name: Eagles Aerie
notes: Excellent view of Alameda Creek canyon and Oak Ridge. Noted as "best" among Sunol Backpack Camp's sites in this project's trip-planning research (source of that ranking not otherwise specified). SPELLED 'EAGLES EYRIE' ON THE OHLONE WILDERNESS PERMIT MAP, which numbers Sunol's seven sites 1-Cathedral, 2-Oak View, 3-Sycamore, 4-Stars Rest, 5-Hawks Nest, 6-Eagles Eyrie, 7-Sky Camp. That numbering confirms all seven names this project holds and disagrees with one of them. Aerie and eyrie are the same word spelled two ways; the key is kept because tests and the campsites join are built on it, and the map's spelling is recorded so a reader matching the two lists is not left wondering. Third EBRPD naming disagreement in three days, after Eagle Spring(s) and Girls'/Girl's Camp.
